name: Southeast Asian
description: Instruments of Vietnam, Indonesia, Laos and Thailand: the đàn tranh zither, angklung, khaen and Thai gongs.
credit: Sounds put together for HO[LO] (CC0): HO[LO] Desk's built-in synths and effects, and the Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (CC0). Each pack keeps its own licence and credit.

source.note: No audio of its own: its sounds play the packs it requires and HO[LO] Desk’s built-in synths.

sounds.name: Đàn Tranh
sounds.note: The Vietnamese zither: bright plucks with bent, sliding notes.

sounds.name: Đàn Tranh Tremolo
sounds.note: Đàn tranh notes played as a fast tremolo.

sounds.name: Angklung
sounds.note: Sundanese bamboo tubes shaken in a frame: a soft, rattling tone (coming with the Angklung pack).

sounds.name: Khaen
sounds.note: The Lao bamboo mouth organ, chords over a drone (coming with the Khaen pack).

sounds.name: Thai Gongs
sounds.note: Tuned bossed gongs (coming with the Iowa percussion).
